metadata.title: Wiclos — Debate with eight, on video
metadata.description: Politics, sport, economy, love... Pick a topic you care about, join seven other strangers and talk it out on video as soon as the circle is complete.

hero.tagline: Politics, money, love: the topics that spark arguments, among 8 strangers.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.step1Text: Politics, sport, economy, culture... browse the topics proposed by the community.
howItWorks.step2Text: Sign up for an existing topic, or propose your own with a date for the discussion.
howItWorks.step3Text: As soon as 8 people have joined, the video call starts automatically at the scheduled time.

categoriesShowcase.title: Topics that really spark debate
